title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
abstract: arXiv:2609.25643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to allocate training adaptively. Evaluated on two reasoning domains, math and multi-hop reasoning, across 1-8B models from different families, LoT consistently improves over KD. translated_title: 思维阶梯：渐进简化推理轨迹的自演化课程
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在参数规模扩展到数千亿时展现出卓越的推理能力，但中小规模模型即使经过知识蒸馏（KD）仍是脆弱的推理者。我们提出了 Ladders-of-Thought（LoT），一个通过将渐进式问题改写与自演化课程相结合来提升推理能力的框架。LoT 自动生成语义忠实但更简单的推理问题变体，使用基于步骤的度量将其组织到不同难度桶中，并采用自演化的多臂老虎机调度器来自适应地分配训练。在数学和多跳推理两个推理领域、跨不同模型系列的 1-8B 模型上进行评估，LoT 始终优于知识蒸馏。它在算术任务上带来大幅提升（例如 AddSub 上提升 32 个百分点，SVAMP 上提升 25 个百分点），在域内测试集上提升 2-8 个百分点，并在多跳推理上带来强劲但依赖于数据集的收益。
tldr: 提出 Ladders-of-Thought 框架，通过自动生成语义忠实但更简单的问题变体、按难度分桶，并用自演化的多臂老虎机调度器自适应分配训练，使中小规模语言模型的推理能力显著超越知识蒸馏基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes Ladders-of-Thought, a framework that automatically generates faithful but easier problem variants, buckets them by difficulty, and adaptively allocates training via a self-evolving bandit scheduler, substantially improving reasoning in small-to-mid-scale LLMs over knowledge distillation.
